api_proxy.title: Configure API Proxy Connection
api_proxy.description:
**CLIProxy**: Uses auth index from your CLIProxy account (leave password empty)
**9Router**: Requires password and base URL (e.g., http://192.168.1.107:20128)

data_description.api_key: Required for 9Router, leave empty for CLIProxy
data_description.account_name: Optional: Display name for this account

trouter.title: Configure Trouter.click Connection
trouter.description: Enter your Trouter.click API key from https://trouter.click

data_description.account_name: Optional: Display name for this account

direct_provider.title: Configure Direct Provider Connection
direct_provider.description:
Connect directly to Claude, Codex, or Antigravity using a session token.

**Claude**: Open claude.ai → DevTools → Application → Cookies → copy `sessionKey`
**Codex**: Open chatgpt.com → DevTools → Application → Cookies → copy `__Secure-next-auth.session-token`
**Antigravity**: Open Settings → Accounts → Copy Bearer Token (or check `%APPDATA%\antigravity\auth.json` → `access_token`)

data_description.data_source: Select the AI provider to connect to
data_description.session_token: Your session token or bearer token (see instructions above)
data_description.account_label: Optional display name, e.g. 'My Claude Max'
